context:
Goal: a home session reads one answer for where questions go and when to stop.
Problem (rule): three pairs of lines in home's CLAUDE.md disagree, and fixing them changes your rulings' words.
Based on (read): the Opus judges' report (22:05 CST).
Based on (ruling): questions-go-to-owner: a lane sends its question to its parent, the coordinator.
Departs from: home CLAUDE.md — line 27 (lane questions go to triage) changes to the coordinator, as line 28 says; the roster clause points at the project instructions on claude.ai, not a CLAUDE.md on branch roadmap; line 46 (stop for an HA change) drops that clause to match line 7 (any HA change, no word needed).

options.gain: One answer per question; no session stops for an HA change you already granted.

options.label: Apply all 3

title: home: settle 3 rules that contradict each other in CLAUDE.md?
